programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.
programme.sub-title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Australia
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: April (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: aster, a time of babies, easter eggs are everywhere as birds get busy breeding, lambs dance around fields and cute baby bunnies emerge from their borrows. Migrants like ospreys and puffins return to their breeding sites. Migrants can come in all shapes and sizes and for different reasons. Hammerhead sharks swarm around Galapagos and take advantage of cleaning services on the reef.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: Marine Mammals - Born to Swim
programme.desc: Every year some 15 million of us around the world cram onto little boats and head out onto the ocean, hoping for the encounter of a lifetime. For centuries whales and dolphins seem to have reached out to us, capturing our imaginations and our souls. Despite their popularity, much of their lives remain a mystery, taking place beneath the waves and beyond our reach.

programme.title: May (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: While we celebrate may day, the coming of summer, there are many changes going on in the world. As snows finally melt in the mountains of Europe, chamois lambs have the chance to test out their climbing skills and explore their vertical home, watching all the time for eagles, their main predators. On the vast plains of the Russian the weird looking saiga antelope have their calves, while Florida enters its fire season and even the everglades can burn

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.
programme.sub-title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: There are more Caribou in Alaska than people! Across the Arctic, they're the lifeblood of many remote communities. But human expansion, and wild predators, have led to their rapid decline. Out on the tundra, Caribou are the prey of choice for Alaska's carnivores, and at a ranch on the edge of Anchorage, the reindeer are at constant risk from the area's wolves and brown bears. The people of Anchorage have vowed to protect them, but will their help be enough for the Caribou to survive?

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf lies on the doorstep of New Zealand's largest city. Every summer millions of visitors from the tropics converge here, all lured by a unique seasonal smorgasbord. Giant oceanic manta rays, rarely filmed in these waters, glide into the gulf. Bryde's whales are also primed for the feasting season, alongside common dolphins, and bronze whaler sharks. In the sky above rare black petrels stalk the dolphins to survive.
programme.sub-title: Te Moananui a Toi/ The Hauraki Gulf

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: One of Alaska's most secretive and efficient predators, Lynx are usually highly elusive... but in Anchorage, houses are being built in the Lynx's territory, forcing these usually shy big cats, to find new ways to survive on the streets. As this urban jungle continues to expand into the wilderness, encounters between people and wild Lynx are on the rise. In this wild city, can people live side by side with Alaska's deadliest big cat?

programme.title: Nature's Cutest
programme.desc: As we all know the natural world can be tough and challenging at times, but it can also be nothing short of adorable. Fluffy white seals, wobbly-kneed fawns, playing polar bear cubs, adorable teddy bear-like koalas - so much cute it would be impossible to decide which was the most adorable. But why do we consider some animals cute and others not? What it is about them that makes us fall in love? Perhaps it's those animals that remind us of ourselves?

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: Animals of the Bible
programme.desc: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: This city spends most of the year encased in ice...but when summer hits, Anchorage bursts into life. Animals and plants living this far north have been forced to adapt, working faster to make the most of the short season, but these animals built to withstand Alaska's extreme winters, often struggle in Anchorage's summer heat! Temperatures can be surprisingly high, with average July highs of 26 degrees C. 300,000 people live alongside these wild animals in the ever growing city of Anchorage.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets one of Africa's most experienced elephant trackers: Hendrick Munembome, the Director of Elephant Human Relations Aid (EHRA). The struggle for water often makes elephants and humans rivals in Namibia. Therefore, EHRA builds water wells for the elephants with volunteers from all over the world, far away from the villages. Hannah helps dig a ditch for a pipeline, then heads up the dry Ugab riverbed in search of the endangered Mama Afrika' herd.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Pacific
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: July (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures, making it home to some of the largest gatherings, and greatest spectacles on the planet.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: On the doorstep of one of the country's biggest cities, Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula provides a breeding refuge for birds and marine mammals. Northern royal albatrosses return here every year to raise their chicks at the world's only mainland colony. On sheltered beaches around the Peninsula, once hunted from these shores, New Zealand sea lions are returning to form a breeding colony after an absence of centuries.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Deep in the Southern Ocean, the Snares islands are one of the most pristine island wildernesses left on the planet. Every summer, millions of seabirds converge here to breed. More than 50,000 endemic Snares crested penguins battle massive Southern Ocean swells to come ashore. Deep in the forest they find their mates and raise their chicks in a frantic race to take advantage of the short subantarctic summer.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

programme.title: Elephants - Changing Lives
programme.desc: Living for over half a century, elephants see the world change around them as they grow. They say an elephant never forgets; if we could enter the massive brain of a veteran elephant, what would we see? Imagine one elephant to represent them all, giving us a unique glimpse into the remarkable life of these magnificent giants.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: In Anchorage, one bird rules the roost...the Bald Eagle. Expert hunters, they are perfectly adapted to life in tough arctic conditions, but in Anchorage, the secret to their survival... is trash. Every day, hundreds of bald eagles gather at the city dump, dodging trucks, machinery, and even pyrotechnics, in search of an easy meal. But this city life also brings constant danger, for the eagles themselves, and also for the human residents.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Bighorn Sheep, Elk, Male Elephants, Marmots, Baboons, Rhinos Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Many animals have evolved chemicals to enhance their chance of survival: some scorpions literally drug their potential mates, others use their poisons to defend or kill. The world of venoms and poisons, the apparatus designed to deliver the payload and the strategies that animals employ to use them most effectively is a rich and varied example of natural selection and evolution in action.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: This episode explores nature's deadliest killers. From a tiny but deadly insect, to a pod of hungry Orca's, predators come in all sizes, and are found on every continent on earth. Chasing, stalking, ambushing or using camouflage, the way each predator hunts, catches and kills food is determined by many factors, including the anatomical adaptations of both the predator and the prey.

programme.title: June (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: It's chaos in the Northern hemisphere, our bird feeders are busy as parents work around the clock to raise their young. There's a baby boom, and young foxes, even in our city centres, leave their dens to explore. Its winter in the south though, cold times for guanacos on the slopes of the Andes. And dry times for elephants in Botswana. They migrate north to the life-giving waters of the Chobe River

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Rhino horn is very expensive in the illegal market and the poachers know it. Kaziranga has the only concentrated population of the one horned Rhino in the world. And poachers are attracted to Kaziranga like ants are to sugar. The primary work of the forest department here is to then protect the rhino from the poachers and save the horn. We meet forest guard Shanti Ram Chetri who after 33 years of glorious service retires.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Life in the Sea
programme.desc: Our planet is one of oceans, and it was this great mass of water that gave birth to Earth's greatest creation - life

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Lions, Chimpanzees, Turtles, Roe Deer, Gannets Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older?

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.sub-title: Chevy C-10 - Part 1: Auto Cross Pretender

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Our 1993 Dodge Ram Dually is back in the shop to have its final dress rehearsal. We'll address a common wiring failure point, then we'll install our seats and show you how to refurbish original door panels to make them look brand new and save some money. The guys give you some pointers when measuring for custom driveshafts. Then we clockout and take Nightshift on it's maiden voyage.

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: We're taking Project Creep it Real out for fun at 2 off-road parks!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We add a body kit and a wrap to our EBC Brakes giveaway Mustang plus, Tommy and Marc bring back the Hellcat '69 Charger.
programme.sub-title: Modding a Mustang GT for an Aggressive Look

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.
programme.sub-title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our 2001 BMW race car, Project Unsanctioned, heads to the paint booth to paint the roll cage. Then we'll head back into the shop for a stylistic wrap and some artistic freedom, before finally assembly and taking it to the track.
programme.sub-title: Artistry In Motion - Project UnSanctioned Part 5

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our 445 FE is back, a modern EFI system, along with a time-tested tunnel wedge intake made for drivability.
programme.sub-title: Junkyard Ford 445 FE Gets Modern EFI

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We start the reassembly of our '78 Postal Jeep, "Junk Mail" with new gears and lockers for our axles. Plus, we drop in our upgraded drivetrain with a 4 to 1 transfer case.
programme.sub-title: Time To Roll! Installing New Gears, Lockers and Drivetrain in Our DJ5 Jeep

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton get to work on their 1990 Mustang. They install a new front and rear suspension in Project Fast Lane Fox Body to handle its new engine.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The guys take a test spin in the Valvoline Giveaway Camaro, and swing by the last remaining drag strip in England for a day of hot passes.
programme.sub-title: Camaro Test Drive and English Drag Racing

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We show you how to fabricate a running engine stand and all of the components you'll need to get your powerplant running.
programme.sub-title: Adding An EFI Setup To The C1500 Chevy

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our 1969 Pontiac GTO, Project Henchman, needs to bulk up before breaking out, so Tommy and Peyton are using the time to modify the chassis and install new fuel lines on this tough prisoner.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Marc and Tommy finish up the interior of our '66 Pontiac convertible. Plus we head out on another Driveway Rescue helping a viewer with their '69 Cutlass project.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Using a custom-built Factory Five chassis, we're building a vehicle for in-depth, on-road engine testing.
programme.sub-title: Building a Dyno Test Sled from a Race Car Chassis

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our '78 Postal Jeep gets an upgraded suspension that can handle the trails. We'll start by fabricating our axles and frame for a 4 link setup.
programme.sub-title: Building a 4-Link Suspension to Conquer the Trails

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.
programme.sub-title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Have you ever seen a super-charged Charger? Tommy and Peyton embark on their next project, a 2019 Dodge Charger, and give it a full super charger upgrade to make sure one lucky Detroit Muscle fan walks away with a sweet ride.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc head out to salvage an old B-Body that has seen better days. Plus look for some hidden treasures in a automotive time capsule.
programme.sub-title: Scouring A Salvage Yard For The Perfect Project: A '69 Plymouth Road Runner

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: It's time to reveal the engine that's going to power the 1969 Charger project, and a viewer's Chevelle gets a helping hand with a Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: Complete coverage of the second annual LS Fest West from Las Vegas Motor Speedway!

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We crank up the power on our old-school GM 4.3L V6 with some turbocharged forced induction.
programme.sub-title: Boosted 4.3L V6 Makes Over 500 lb-ft On The Dyno!

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our shop's latest addition is a cylinder hone that'll make quick work of custom engines.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: If you want to make power, you need to have a plan! Today, we'll cover the engine requirements and parts selection needed to get the horsepower number you desire.
programme.sub-title: How To Plan Your Engine Build: To Make Power, You Need to Have a Plan

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: We're getting our Coyote engine and transmission installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: LT and Austin pull a '65 C10 project off the rollback and make plans for its revival.
programme.sub-title: Bringing Back To Life '65 Chevy C10

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our 1972 Camaro gets outfitted with a custom roll cage to help strengthen the chassis. Plus, we strip down the front subframe prepping it for cleanup.
programme.sub-title: Strengthening The Chassis Of The 1972 Camaro Split Bumper

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We take a road trip to the outskirts of St. Louis to meet with the team responsible for Bigfoot! We have access to the inner workings, get a sneak peek at a new Bigfoot, and we're going to drive a monster truck!
programme.sub-title: Building Bigfoot: What It Takes To Create A Monster Truck

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Our '96 Honda Civic Rally car gets some racing seats for comfort and a rally cage for added safety.
programme.sub-title: Honda Civic Rally Ripper Gets Safety & Seat Upgrades

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: An interior dress-up for a 50 year old tow truck giving it new life on the road.
programme.sub-title: Adding Class & Comfort to Our Square Body, Then Parking Lot Revenge

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: The crew from Carcass needs plenty of power to move their 1-ton military truck. Our answer: supercharge a 383 ci V8!
programme.sub-title: Blown 383 Stroker Has Trouble on the Dyno: What Happened?

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We lay out our plan to rebuild our 1985 Chevy K-10. We start by tearing it down and building it back up with new sheet metal repair. What we have in mind for this truck will make you do a double-take!
programme.sub-title: Diving Deep Into The Tear Down Of The Faux Guy Square Body

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: What's heating up the track at the American Endurance Racing Mid-Ohio Event? From inside where all the action takes place, strap in and hang on. Plus, mocking up the dyno test sled for a new boosted Coyote.
programme.sub-title: Mocking Up ta Coyote in our Rolling Dyno Test Sled

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass crew brings their abandoned Chevy project back. They'll add some mild performance upgrades to the engine. Plus, spruce up the interior and exterior with fresh pieces.
programme.sub-title: Adding More Horsepower To The Abandoned Chevy Silverado Salvage Yard LS Swap

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We pay it forward helping to resurrect a Camaro that is more than just a car for its owner. And we'll head to Las Vegas to meet some Matco Tools merchants who believe in making a living through giving.
programme.sub-title: Resurrecting A '67 Camaro From Nightmare To Dream Car

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: A high-compression 632 ci Big Block Chevy provides massive power for XOR's Willys Wagon.
programme.sub-title: 632 ci Big Block Chevy Build for Project Wild & Willys

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We've got the tips and techniques for Stroking a 408 ci Windsor. So, what does it take to make big power?
programme.sub-title: How Can an Old 408ci Windsor Make 500HP?

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our '81 Mustang Cobra gets fuel and cooling systems and Project Street Regal gets some upgrades to its dated interior.
programme.sub-title: Installing a Cooling and Fuel System in a Cobra Foxbody

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our 1969 Dodge Charger gets an all-new rear suspension and an upgraded dash.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We get our hands on Ford's new 7.3 liter pushrod V-8 Godzilla engine and see how it stacks up against the other BIG 3 swap engines. After doing a baseline test, we'll make some modifications by throwing the Engine Power touch on it and see what this beast lays down in the dyno cell.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Mike and Pat stroke a vintage junkyard Ford 390 but an unexpected surprise puts a delay in their progress. Then it's full steam ahead for finding the limit for this big block stump puller
programme.sub-title: Junkyard Ford 390 FE Teardown and Rebuild

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: All of the mechanical and electrical systems are getting buttoned up on our '85 Buick Street Regal. That includes tips and techniques for custom hoses and brake lines.
programme.sub-title: Tips for Custom Brake Lines and Hoses

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: We take a responsible turn on our Sierra Denali to make big power, yet keep it street legal. Plus a new twist on exhaust cutouts for late model pick ups.
programme.sub-title: Installing the 6.6L LML Duramax Back Into Our '11 Sierra Denali

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The MCT shop has the chassis back from powder coat. We start putting all of the pieces together, and install some of the vital components to get our sport truck up and running.
programme.sub-title: OBS 632 SS Part 6 Some Assembly Required

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We find a parked Honda Civic and try to get it back on the road. Then take it to the shop and start planning what to build.
programme.sub-title: Transforming a Honda Civic Hatchback Into The Ultimate Rally Car Part 1

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We are on the home stretch of our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Slam Project. We begin to button things up, including the driveshaft, exhaust, shocks and more. The end is in sight as we get closer to laying frame.
programme.sub-title: Low-Fi S-10: This Project is Coming Together

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our Granada has plenty of Seventies Style, but precious little power. This sounds like a good candidate for a sleeper build!
programme.sub-title: Disguising a High Revving 347 for our Sleeper Granada

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Jeremy Weckman and Jimmy King transform an under powered surplus military ambulance into an iconic Willys Wagon.
programme.sub-title: Chevy M1010 is Transformed Into Willy's Wagon

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: A '72 Dodge Dart gets a second lease on life after an eight-year outdoor slumber.
programme.sub-title: Transforming A '72 Dodge Dart From Lawn Ornament To Pavement Pounder

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We've got big plans for this aluminum block! That includes stroking it to 419ci, along with a fully-forged rotating assembly that's ready for a power adder!

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Willys Mud Wagon gets a 630HP powerhouse that screams, and Jeremy and Jimmy take FrankenRegal out for a mudding adventure.
programme.sub-title: Hear The Willys' 383 Stroker Small Block Chevy Roar

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make high power starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.
programme.sub-title: How to Build a High Power Diesel Beast

programme.title: HorsePower
programme.desc: A champion Pro Stock racer pitches in to bring a '55 Chevy back to life. And the guys will install and test some new supercharger technology.
programme.sub-title: Restarting a '55 Chevy 350 Small Block After Sitting for Over 10 Years

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: Part 4 of the Drifting Trailblazer. Jeremy and Jimmy wear out some tires with their drifting Trailblazer SS, after pushing it past 500HP on the dyno.
programme.sub-title: Supercharging Our Drift Trailblazer To Push It Past the 500 HP Threshold

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: A marriage made in heaven - Our Fat Stack Caprice gets reunited with our updated chassis. Then it gets lined out with a new fuel system to ensure this LS can handle all of the horsepower of this heavy Chevy.
programme.sub-title: Reuniting The '71 Chevy Caprice With Its Updated Chassis

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: We will up the fuel economy and up the performance on our 6.7L Ram 3500, plus our Driveway Rescue viewer gets a needed tuneup on his '04 Ford F150.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The guys work hard to finish their 1974 build under the hood, under the frame, and under the top because this prized new Bronco will be on its way to the SEMA Show in Las Vegas.
programme.sub-title: Buttoned Up & Shipped Off: The Classic Bronco Gets Its Final Assembly

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our '76 Caddy gets help to make that engine come to life. We install a custom exhaust, & add fuel and air goodies to make Overtaker rise from the ashes.
programme.sub-title: Waking Up Our Caddy Hearse With A New Exhaust & Fuel Upgrades

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue
programme.sub-title: SeaFoam Camaro Finish Up and Payoff

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass builders bring in an old 1984 Chevrolet Land Yacht to give it some custom touches for some family fun. They will tear down and clean up 40 years of dirt, then start replacing worn out suspension parts to get this wagon road worthy.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: The start to finish transformation of a stock '88 K1500 Sierra into a lowered LS-powered all-wheel-drive beast.
programme.sub-title: Lowered '88 K1500 Sierra Turns Into a Lowered LS-Powered Beast

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We begin adding accessories to our 2016 Toyota 4Runner Overlanding Project to get it ready for its next big adventure. We'll add a winch, roof top tent, LED lights, and more!
programme.sub-title: Overlanding Toyota 4Runner Gets Essential Off Road Accessories - Part 3

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We picked up a 1985 Chevy K-10 with a plan to do a full rebuild. But with just a few small repairs and upgrades that you can do in your driveway, we can get this Chevy back on its feet. Next stop? We're going offroad for a little trail action!
programme.sub-title: Getting The K10 Square Body Up and Running

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The 632 OBS Chevy is in the final lap of completion. We'll finish up the interior with new seats and gauge cluster. Then we'll add one more detail to accentuate our exterior, before hitting the streets and the strip.
programme.sub-title: OBS 632 SS Part 8 Sport Truck Assemble/Crossing the Finish Line

These natives of Rio de Janeiro are lovable scamps who somehow find ways to avoid work altogether, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars. Mr. Bourdain, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try, enjoying a savage tan, Brazilian barbecue, and one too many Caipirinhas!

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fishermans soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal & South-West France: Visiting his boss's family farm, Tony helps slaughter and feast on a pig the family has been fattening all year. Then, Tony heads to France to experience the rich delights of a foie gras farm.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY Provincetown, MA - Experience the formative moments of Tonys career as he revisits his first job, the culinary institute that taught him the basics, a normal workday at Les Halles Brasserie, and his mysterious mentor, Bigfoot.
programme.sub-title: My Life As a Cook - NYC

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New Orleans, Louisiana: In New Orleans, Anthony Bourdain catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world famous sno cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and finally kicks back to enjoy some local jazz.
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Chaing Mai, Thailand: Jumping into a Thai tuk tuk taxi, Bourdain attempts to soak up Thai culture and get lost in the cuisine of Chaing Mai. From spicy soups and noodles in the busy city, to the hospitality and delicate salads of the countryside, Tony learns to appreciate all things Thai.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland - Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Cambodia: With a friend along for the ride, Tony travels to Phnom Penh, Cambodia, where he explores a food culture that is both pleasing to the palette and slightly frightening.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Singapore: Chef Anthony Bourdain decides to find the real Singapore with its multicultural restaurants and markets. He samples prescription food dishes, explores the Geyland Serai Market, rides the clean and efficient subway, and sees Singapore's diversity in the "Little India" neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: Singapore: New York in Twenty Years

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: St. Martin: In an attempt to escape the stress of city life, Anthony visits the island of St. Martin. In this Caribbean paradise, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, discovers foodstuffs not available at American supermarkets, and finally relaxes at a beach bar.
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better with Sand Between Your Toes

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: London, England - In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo where he discovers a radically new cooking attitude. He visits Tokyos largest fresh fish market and is introduced to the culinary diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: San Sebastian, Spain: Tony explores the food-crazed Basque culture. Tony's guide, Chef Luis Irizar, takes Tony into the underworld of Basque gastronomic societies. Later, Tony explores the citys tapas bars.
programme.sub-title: San Sebastian: A Food Lover's Town

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Salvador, Brazil: Known as Brazil's capital of happiness, Salvador da Bahia offers fruitful local markets and rich Bahian cuisine: fried shrimp, palm oil, chili peppers, and coconut. Here, Tony takes part in a tradional ceremony, and experiences the culinary talents of the famous Bahian, Chef Dada.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

In search of the outlaws of food, Tony explores a pasteurization-free cheese factory, and an old-world cured jamon workshop. Alas, no trip to Australia is complete without an authentic "barbie", so Bourdain settles down with new found friends for an afternoon meal of surf n' turf.
programme.sub-title: Down Under: The Wild West of Cooking

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

programme.title: Addicted
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Zoe Reynard (Sharon Leal) seems to have a charmed life. She has a wonderful, loving husband (Boris Kodjoe), two beautiful children and a thriving career. However, as perfect as her life might look to other people, Zoe is secretly tormented by nymphomania. Her need for constant sexual gratification leads her into a secretive existence -- one that, ultimately, may put her family, career and life on the line. Based on a novel by Zane.

programme.title: Beyonce: Queen B
programme.desc: One of the most recognizable figures in contemporary music. Get lost in the ultimate story of modern day superstardom as we take you through the incredible journey of Beyoncé. Directed by Billy Simpson.

programme.title: After Skid Row
programme.desc: After Skid Row documents the journey of Barbie Carter as she navigates the transition to housed life following the brutal reality of a decade on the streets. Her unique story and compelling character help to both demystify and deeply personalize a homelessness epidemic that continues to swell across Los Angeles. Directed by Lindsey Hagen.

programme.title: The Madeleine McCann Case
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of Madeleine McCanns disappearance in 2003, and follows through the years up until the reservoir search in 2023. Featuring interviews with internationally recognised British Criminologist Dr Graham Hill, and Police Detective Peter Bleksly. It is every parents worst nightmare. Their daughter, only three years of age, taken from her bed.. with no clue left behind. Seconds turned to minutes, minutes into hours, hours into days...

programme.title: Selena Gomez: Devotion
programme.desc: After returning from her five year break from music, Selena Gomez has blown the world away with her third studio album Rare. She has transformed over the years, from Disney pop star to award winning film and tv producer. She is one of the biggest stars in Hollywood and is certain one of the most devoted to her art. This is the life and career of Selena Gomez. Directed by Matt Salmon.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A New Life In Hollywood
programme.desc: Ever since the former Duke and Duchess of Sussex left royal life for Los Angeles tension has mounted between the two households. The world demanded answers and so much more than they could have ever imagined after the infamous interview rocked the world and left the royal family on the brink of disaster. Has their dramatic exit from royal duties changed royal history forever? The decision was clear - duty or love?

programme.title: Meghan Markle: Unforgiven
programme.desc: Drama, controversy, reconciliation. Meghan Markle was thrown into the spotlight in 2017 after her whirlwind romance with Prince Harry took centre stage. Falling in and out of favour with the press and public alike, Meghan has proven to divide the opinions of royal followers around the world. This is her story. Directed by Nick Randall.

programme.title: Beyonce: Queen B
programme.desc: One of the most recognizable figures in contemporary music. Get lost in the ultimate story of modern day superstardom as we take you through the incredible journey of Beyoncé. Directed by Billy Simpson.

programme.title: Salam Neighbor
programme.desc: Two filmmakers fully embed themselves in a Syrian refugee camp, providing an intimate look at the world's most dire humanitarian crisis. Directed by Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci.

programme.title: Princess Diana: Unexpected Icon
programme.desc: Diana Spencer was that quiet shy girl who every young lady could relate to. The difference with her is that she became a princess. From then on she shot up into stardom to become one of the biggest icons, not only in the UK, but in the entire world. Directed by Nick Randall.

programme.title: Killing John F. Kennedy
programme.desc: John F Kennedy was one of America's greatest presidents. He was the voice of the people. His influence helped push America through the most dangerous moments of the cold war, diffusing what could have been world nuclear destruction. But in November 1963, his life would come to a devastating end through the hands of an assassin. But who would kill one of the most popular presidents? Why was he a target? Directed by Matt Salmon.

programme.title: Banksy: Street Rat
programme.desc: Banksy changed the modern art world, taking it from galleries and onto the street. His identity has always been hidden from the public; keeping this secret was key to avoiding any criminal charges. He made headlines for his Kissing Coppers, painted the West Bank Wall and walked into galleries and hung his own work. Banksy is one of the best-known artists of the 21st Century, yet, does anybody know who he really is? Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Days
programme.desc: Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WW2. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind. This documentary gives insight into the last days of Hitler's life as well as his death. With expert contributors like Guy Walters and Dr. Lisa Pine, this project uncovers an intriguing perspective on history. Directed by Daria Tuca.

programme.title: Dolphin Lover
programme.desc: Dolphin Lover is a critically acclaimed, award winning short documentary on the incredible true story of Malcolm Brenner and his summer long love affair with Dolly the dolphin. Directed by Joey Daoud and Kareem Tabsch.

programme.title: The Last 24 Hours: Jimi Hendrix
programme.desc: This documentary offers an in-depth look at Jimi Hendrix's last 24 hours and attempts to clear the air surrounding his tragic passing by including appearances and testimonials from some of the people that knew him best. Directed by Mike Parkinson.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Dennis Nilsen
programme.desc: Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophile who murdered at least twelve young men and boys between 1978 and 1983 in London. Directed by Remone Jones.

programme.title: We Are Oscar Mike
programme.desc: Through his non-profit foundation, Oscar Mike, Noah helps rehabilitate other veterans through the adaptive sports that saved his own life. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: Your Royal Invitation
programme.desc: You are invited to the most anticipated royal event of the year. The long-awaited wedding of Great Britain's Prince Harry and American actress, activist and sweetheart Meghan Markle. On November 27th, 2017 the couple will be in Windsor Castle. This show follows the build-up to the big day. We'll inspect the plans, uncover how this is going to be, and chart Meghan's journey from young star to Royal Princess.

programme.title: The Barbie Story
programme.desc: Barbie is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic, she is way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a children's sensation. Wildly revolutionary, Barbie broke barriers, shattered glass ceilings, and has inspired countless dreams, wonder and imagination. The history of the doll is a testament to its enduring appeal and impact. Things have changed for her the same way things changed for women.

programme.title: Beyonce: Queen B
programme.desc: One of the most recognizable figures in contemporary music. Get lost in the ultimate story of modern day superstardom as we take you through the incredible journey of Beyoncé. Directed by Billy Simpson.

programme.title: Salam Neighbor
programme.desc: Two filmmakers fully embed themselves in a Syrian refugee camp, providing an intimate look at the world's most dire humanitarian crisis. Directed by Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci.

programme.title: Elton John: A Life In Song
programme.desc: Elton John's career has spanned decades, but his legacy is more than just his music. Reginald Dwight's early debut was in the band Bluesology - there he would meet lyricist Bernie Taupin whom he would go on to write over 30 albums with. After parting ways with the band and his birth name, the Rocketman was born. Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: In My Own Words: Little Big
programme.desc: DOCUMENTARY+ invited Ilya Prusikin to share their personal story. Ilya is a musician, songwriter, and lead vocalist of the Russian pop-rave superband, Little Big. Ilya recounts the on the ground events of February 24th, the day Russia invaded Ukraine, the group's journey to seek political asylum in the United States, and navigating being labeled a traitor by the Russian government for being outspoken against the war. Directed by Yasir Masood.

programme.title: The Last 24 Hours: Amy Winehouse
programme.desc: After a very public battle with addiction the world was saddened to hear the shocking news that Amy Winehouse was found dead in her bedroom at the young age of 27. We investigate what really happened during the final 24 hours of the singer's life, with exclusive interviews and testimonials. Directed by Jordan Hill.

programme.title: Britney Spears: Unbreakable
programme.desc: Look into the glamorous and tumultuous life of pop sensation Britney Spears. From her incredible skyrocketing ascent into stardom to her personal troubles and downfalls, see the inside of the star's life with exclusive interviews. Directed by Sonia Anderson.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A New Life In Hollywood
programme.desc: Ever since the former Duke and Duchess of Sussex left royal life for Los Angeles tension has mounted between the two households. The world demanded answers and so much more than they could have ever imagined after the infamous interview rocked the world and left the royal family on the brink of disaster. Has their dramatic exit from royal duties changed royal history forever? The decision was clear - duty or love?

programme.title: Meghan Markle: American Duchess
programme.desc: Meghan's rise to the top of British society revealed some deep- seated issues in a multicultural country. How did the most adored woman in the world become the subject of such vicious tabloid gossip? Directed by Lucy Ciara McCutcheon.

programme.title: Barbie's Pink World
programme.desc: She is plastic, she is fantastic. She's Barbie of course. But she is way more than just plastic, she is way more than a toy. The pretty blond has become a worldwide sensation especially after the blockbuster movie starring Margot Robbie and directed by Greta Gerwig. Barbie's been around for so long, but hasn't aged a day. She's had more than 200 different jobs; she's been president, she's been to the moon, and she's done all the things that women want to do.

programme.title: Selena Gomez: Devotion
programme.desc: After returning from her five year break from music, Selena Gomez has blown the world away with her third studio album Rare. She has transformed over the years, from Disney pop star to award winning film and tv producer. She is one of the biggest stars in Hollywood and is certain one of the most devoted to her art. This is the life and career of Selena Gomez. Directed by Matt Salmon.

45365 explores the congruities of daily life in an American town. From the patrol car to the courtroom, the playground to the nursing home, the parade to the prayer service, it explores relationships and interactions - with people and their environment. The stories of a father and son, a young relationship, cops and criminals, officials and their electorate coalesce into a mosaic of faces, places, and events. 45365 is a portrait of a city and its people. Directed by Turner Ross and Bill Ross IV.

programme.title: Picture Locked: Chris Temple & Zach Ingrasci
programme.desc: Filmmakers Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci break down their work, including "Five Years North." Directed by Yasir Masood & Victor Kamwendo.

programme.title: How To Make A Rainbow
programme.desc: The story of a young girl and her mother, observed over the course of two years, as they move together through transitions of home, identity and name. Directed by Ryan Maxey.

programme.title: Eleanor Ambos Interiors
programme.desc: As a celebrated interior designer loses her eyesight to macular degeneration, she begins to see her life's work in a new light. This eccentric renegade topples ageist stereotypes as she grapples with the limitations of her aging body. Directed by Katrina Sorrentino and Andrew Ellis.

programme.desc: A group of friends use Siri to guide them as they band together to start a farm, in a short documentary by Jonathan Pickett.

programme.desc: CIA legend Tony Mendez masterminded the escape of six diplomats from revolutionary Iran during the 1979 hostage crisis by dressing them up as a Canadian film crew.

programme.title: The Chicago Mob: Deadly Associates
programme.desc: On Sept. 27, 1974, businessman Danny Seifert was gunned down in broad daylight; Danny's wife, Emma, and his young son, Joey, began a quest for revenge that stretches from the mean streets of Chicago to the glitz and glamour of Las Vegas.

programme.title: Mafia Killers With Colin McLaren
programme.desc: Sammy "the Bull" Gravano, a vicious hit man with 19 murders to his name, runs a string of lucrative businesses and becomes the loyal and extremely dangerous underboss of New York's biggest crime family.

programme.title: Mafia Killers With Colin McLaren
programme.desc: John Gotti murders his way to the top of New York's most powerful Mafia family; indictments come and go, but nothing sticks; rich, powerful and in love with himself, Gotti becomes enthralled with the glare of the media lights.

programme.title: Most Shocking
programme.desc: After a driver rams a police car, he trades a stint in traffic school for jail time; a driver in a semi-truck is no match for Mother Nature when he gets caught in a Category 3 hurricane.

programme.title: Most Shocking
programme.desc: Police defuse an indecent threat from a naked man who claims to have explosives in his car; a bare-bottomed holdup man distracts a store clerk during a beer heist; streakers get left in the cold when their getaway car is stolen.

programme.title: Most Shocking
programme.desc: After a racetrack crash leaves a couple of drivers out of the money, they finish the competition with their fists; two women's dance-off at a club gets out of hand; anarchists clash with riot police in Argentina.

programme.title: On Patrol: Live
programme.desc: Beech Grove officers respond to reports of a driver ramming into other vehicles.

programme.title: On Patrol: Live
programme.desc: Officers are called to a hotel after a woman refuses to leave in Everett, Wash.

programme.title: America's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Retired Special Agent Cain Vincent Dyer, also known as "Kangaroo Bandit", and more, join John and Callahan to discuss the cases featured.

programme.title: America's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Breaking down tough cases in the pursuit of justice with the help of an accomplished team of law enforcement experts.

programme.title: Clancy Once Again
programme.desc: The sequel to 2008's 'Clancy' finds Nick, Avery, Chief Payne,( and a few new faces) living different lives and facing new challenges at every turn.

programme.title: Discovering the Bible
programme.desc: Despite attempts of tyrants to destroy it, the Bible has endured and become the most translated and circulated book ever. It was translated into various art forms and given to us in English through heroic efforts.

programme.title: Discovering Apostle Paul
programme.desc: Throughout history, the Dardanelles have been a barrier between Asia and Europe. It was here in 1915 that Australian forces were called on to attack Turkey as part of British plans during World War 1. Almost 2000 years earlier, the Apostle Paul pioneered the spread of the Gospel into Europe in this same area when he heard the call to 'come over and help us'.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? Was this one in a series of events foretelling the End Times? Stories abound of the appearance of mysterious troops and sophisticated weaponry that aided the Israelis in their victory. Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.title: Breaking the Silence
programme.desc: The story of Lester and Rebecca Graber, an Amish minister who began to read and study the Bible.

programme.title: Remember the Goal
programme.desc: A young female coach fresh out of college takes over the cross country program at an all girls' Christian school and attempts to lead them to their first ever state title. As the runners begin to train, the top five girls all deal separately with particular issues relevant to teen life. As each of these stories unfold, so does the wisdom of the young coach as she guides the girls along the pathway of life

programme.title: Me & You, Us, Forever
programme.desc: A 47 year old Christian man (Michael Blain-Rozgay) is on the other side of an unwanted divorce. Searching for answers to ease the pain and make sense of his life, he meets a woman (Stacey J. Aswad) at a divorce recovery group. The two forge a friendship and find they have a common bond: both have been thinking about their lost first loves. As he reminisces about his old high school girlfriend, he regrets he ever broke up with her...and now....wants to see her again.

programme.title: A Matter of Faith
programme.desc: A Christian girl, Rachel Whitaker (Jordan Trovillion) goes off to college for her freshman year and begins to be influenced by her popular Biology professor (Harry Anderson) who teaches that evolution is the answer to the origins of life. When Rachel's father, Stephen Whitaker (Jay Pickett) senses something changing with his daughter, he begins to examine the situation and what he discovers catches him completely off guard.

programme.title: The Secrets of Jonathan Sperry
programme.desc: Best buddies Dustin (Jansen Panettiere), Albert and Mark are twelve year old boys looking forward to a summer of fun in 1970. When Dustin mows the lawn of seventy-five year old Jonathan Sperry (Gavin MacLeod), a man he has seen at church, a unique friendship develops. What happens the rest of this summer is something Dustin and his friends will never forget!

programme.title: The Life of Jesus
programme.desc: Perhaps the best drama about the life of Jesus based on the Gospel of John

programme.title: Unidentified
programme.desc: An incident occurs in a small Texas town. A man, while driving at night home on a back highway, claims to have encountered a UFO. Two reporters from a national magazine are sent to investigate; their editor wants to publish a story on the controversial subject of UFOs. Brad (Josh Adamson) thinks they're a hoax but Keith (Jonathan Aube) senses that something is out there. What follows is a quest by each man to prove the other wrong. Are UFOs real? A hoax? Is there an explanation?

programme.title: Remember the Goal

As the runners begin to train, the top five girls all deal separately with particular issues relevant to teen life. As each of these stories unfold, so does the wisdom of the young coach as she guides the girls along the pathway of life

programme.title: Return to the Hiding Place
programme.desc: When the Nazis begin killing Jews in Holland, a group of youth fight to save the lives of the innocent.

programme.title: The Secrets of Jonathan Sperry
programme.desc: Best buddies Dustin (Jansen Panettiere), Albert and Mark are twelve year old boys looking forward to a summer of fun in 1970. When Dustin mows the lawn of seventy-five year old Jonathan Sperry (Gavin MacLeod), a man he has seen at church, a unique friendship develops. What happens the rest of this summer is something Dustin and his friends will never forget!

programme.title: The Perfect Race
programme.desc: Allee-Sutton Hethcoat reprises her role as Coach Courtney Smith-Donnelly from 'Remember The Goal' in 'The Perfect Race'. She works with a female athlete at a small Christian college who tries to overcome long odds and win a national title in the 800 meter run. Coach Donnelly's training methods and teachings about life both line up with the concept that in order to win...you first have to lose.

programme.title: Princess Cut
programme.desc: A lifelong Carolina farm girl, now in her early 20's, Grace has dreamed all her life of the day when "Mr. Right" slips a Princess Cut diamond on her finger and swears to love her forever. Tonight may be that night as Stewart has something special planned after 15 months together! But when things don't go as planned, and romance crashes down around her, it launches her on a quest, aided by her father, to understand what it means to truly love another person.

programme.title: Time Changer
programme.desc: The year is 1890 and Bible Professor Russell Carlisle has written a manuscript and is set to receive an unanimous endorsement from the board at Grace Bible Seminary. Professor Carlisle's friend and colleague, Dr. Norris Anderson dissents, raising an objection. Using a secret time machine, Anderson sends Carlisle over 100 years into the future, offering him a glimpse of where his beliefs will lead.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: The book of Esther tells the story of a beautiful orphan who hides her Jewish identity, becomes Queen of Persia and saves her people from destruction. A controversial figure, Esther has been criticized for being a 'bad Jew'; flouting tradition, marrying a gentile and being vengeful and bloodthirsty. Still, with great courage, wisdom and imagination, she stops a pogrom.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: The setting: a late afternoon in Jerusalem 3,000 years ago. A beautiful young woman bathes on the roof at dusk, spied by the lustful eyes of a hidden admirer. The admirer, King David, is supposed to be on the battlefield with his troops. And the woman, Bathsheba, is married. Her husband is a general in David's army.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: Samson may have been the classic biblical Israeli strong man, but he was no match for a pretty young Philistine named Delilah. We all think we know this traditional tale, but do we? Was Delilah a pawn, a Judas or a survivor? Hers is a rich, complex story of romance, betrayal and revenge that will bring down the house as we explore this legend from an entirely new perspective.

programme.title: Notorious Women of the Bible
programme.desc: No biblical woman is more reviled than Jezebel. Her name is still synonymous with feminine evil. Jezebel's story is a rich mix of historical events, allegorical interpretation and metaphorical licence. At the climax of her long struggle to bring pagan worship to the kingdom of Israel, Queen Jezebel paid a terrible price.

programme.desc: The story of Eve opens with a vision of loneliness, companionship, desire and love. We also consider how stereotypes of Eve haunt our societal view of women today.

programme.desc: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music . Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati experiences the Escaramuza- An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.
programme.sub-title: Cantina Culture and the Morning After?

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.
programme.sub-title: Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Body at Brighton Rock
programme.desc: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run.

programme.title: Surveillance
programme.desc: After a spree of horrific murders in the New Mexico desert, two FBI agents arrive at a small Sante Fe police station to interview the key witnesses. Using elaborate surveillance equipment to view the interrogations simultaneously, Sam Hallaway watches as his partner cross examines the three survivors. As several inconsistencies emerge, it becomes clear that somebody in the room knows the truth behind the slayings.

programme.title: Boarding Gate
programme.desc: A sordid and complex series of events unfolds when an ex-prostitute (Asia Argento) becomes involved with a couple in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Wave
programme.desc: A Norwegian geologist (Kristoffer Joner) and his family (Ane Dahl Torp, Jonas Hoff Oftebro) fight for survival when a massive landslide causes a 250-foot tidal wave.

programme.title: The Quake
programme.desc: A geologist races against time to save his estranged wife and two children when a devastating earthquake strikes Oslo, Norway.

programme.title: The Burning Sea
programme.desc: A submarine operator descends to the ocean floor to save the man she loves from a sunken oil rig.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer hunts a widow in the wilderness after she escapes from his remote cabin in the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A widow (Kim Hye-ja) resides with her mentally challenged son (Won-bin) in a small South Korean town, where she scrapes out a living selling medicinal herbs. Mother and son are plunged into a nightmare when the body of a murdered young girl is discovered. Circumstantial evidence indicates the son's involvement, and he becomes the prime suspect during the sloppy police investigation. Betrayed by the legal system, the mother takes the law into her own hands to clear her son's name.

programme.title: High-Rise
programme.desc: A doctor (Tom Hiddleston) moves into a London skyscraper where rising tensions and class warfare lead to anarchy.

programme.title: Trollhunter
programme.desc: While investigating reports of illegal poaching, three student filmmakers encounter a man (Otto Jespersen) who slays trolls for the Norwegian government.

programme.title: Pulse
programme.desc: After her boyfriend commits suicide, a psychology student (Kristen Bell) and her friends begin receiving unsettling e-mails and video messages. After a number of disappearances across campus, she teams up with a computer hacker (Ian Somerhalder) to shut down the deadly force before it spreads to the rest of the world.

programme.title: The Last Circus
programme.desc: A twisted love triangle develops among a Spanish clown (Carlos Areces), his cruel rival (Antonio de la Torre) and the rival's abused -- but lustful -- wife (Carolina Bang).

programme.title: The Gravedigger
programme.desc: When a lonely gravedigger discovers Frankenstein's monster hiding in the cemetery, he must decide whether to help the creature or turn him over to the murderous Dr. Victor Frankenstein.

programme.title: Ultrasound
programme.desc: Driving home during a rainstorm, Glen experiences car trouble and gets help from a strange couple that gives him an offer he can't refuse. At the same time, Katie is feeling weighed down by a secret and a medical practitioner questions an experiment.

programme.title: Mutant Chronicles
programme.desc: In the 28th century, four rival corporations are in a constant state of war for control of the Earth. During one such battle, an ancient machine is uncovered and reactivated, and starts churning out undead mutants by the hundreds. While the corporations make plans to abandon the Earth, a strike force led by Maj. Mitch Hunter (Thomas Jane) and clergyman Brother Samuel (Ron Perlman), embark on a mission to destroy the machine before the mutants overrun the planet.

programme.title: Fear PHarm
programme.desc: Members of a deranged family use the world's scariest maze to hunt unsuspecting teens with perfect skin.

programme.title: Amulet
programme.desc: Terror strikes when a former soldier takes a job to help a young woman and her housebound mother.

programme.title: Let the Right One In
programme.desc: When Oskar (Kåre Hedebrant), a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy living with his mother in suburban Sweden, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli (Lina Leandersson), they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

programme.title: Sunset on the River Styx
programme.desc: A chance meeting of two morose lovers sends them spiraling down a surreal rabbit hole. Their relationship will be challenged by their pasts, their futures, their perception of time, and a vampire death cult.

programme.title: The Signal
programme.desc: Mya (Anessa Ramsey) and Ben (Justin Welborn) are very much in love, but she cannot quite find the courage to leave her awful husband, Lewis (A.J. Bowen). However, when a mysterious transmission starts turning people, including Lewis, into murderous maniacs, the lovers must go on the run.

programme.title: XX
programme.desc: Filmmakers Jovanka Vuckovic, Annie Clark, Roxanne Benjamin and Karyn Kusama present four horrific tales of terror. In "The Box," a boy (Peter DaCunha) starts to display strange behavior after looking inside a mysterious gift box. In "The Birthday Party," a woman (Melanie Lynskey) refuses to let an untimely death ruin her son's bash. In "Don't Fall," an innocent camping trip turns deadly, and in "Her Only Living Son," a mother (Christina Kirk) must deal with the child from hell.

programme.title: 616 Wilford Lane
programme.desc: A grieving man relocates his two teenage daughters to a charming town and into their dream home. Quickly, the dream becomes an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: 12 Hour Shift

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
